title: Benchmark provider quality and all-in cost
description: Compare Brave, Exa, Parallel turbo/basic/advanced, and Gemini grounding where credentials/model access permit using the same representative task corpus. Record relevance, freshness, hard filters, latency, result context, token/search charges, free-tier accounting, and failure behavior before changing automatic routing.

logs.msg: Hardened direct Exa normalization: malformed individual results are discarded without hiding valid evidence, empty highlights fall back to text/summary, optional billing metadata is non-fatal, and the standard 10-result call exposes the current $0.007 estimate for bounded research budgets. Verified Exa tests and bun run typecheck; commit 957a9c8 pushed.
Correction: the Exa estimate is $0.007 per standard 10-result call; the previous log entry lost the dollar sign to shell expansion.
